figurative_meaning_en: An assembly of abundant food items
example_sentences_in_bangla: উৎসবে ভোজ খেয়ে সবাই খুশি হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: A grand feast has been arranged at home.
Everyone was happy after eating at the festival feast.
history: References a line from Sukumar Ray's poem: 'খাওয়ার আজব খাওয়া ভোজ কয় যাহারে'
note: The idiom draws from literary usage in Bengali nonsense verse, emphasizing extravagance in feasting.
